categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the digital government and smart enterprise sectors, providing integrated information technology services including software development, system integration, and IT operation and maintenance. Key business areas include digital government solutions, smart enterprise digital transformation, education examination systems, digital finance, market supervision, smart agriculture, law enforcement supervision, and intelligent manufacturing with a focus on machine vision products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include AI-driven large models, big data, blockchain, cloud computing, machine vision, IoT, and data asset management platforms. The company emphasizes 'AI+' capabilities, developing proprietary government large models and data infrastructure such as trusted data spaces and public data authorization platforms. Production methods involve software development, system integration, and platform-based service delivery with continuous R&D in AI, machine vision, and data services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government agencies at national, provincial, municipal, and county levels, public institutions, and large to medium-sized enterprises across various industries including finance, telecommunications, manufacturing, education, healthcare, and agriculture. The company serves over 20 provinces in China and has expanded into international markets such as Russia and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operating region is China, with a strong presence in Hunan province and expanding coverage in Central China, East China, South China, North China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It also has growing international market penetration in Russia, West Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, East Africa, West Africa, and Eastern Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the IT service supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and IT services for digital government and enterprise customers. It also extends into upstream hardware production through its subsidiary developing intelligent computing products based on domestic chip ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI integration, especially large model applications in digital government and enterprise scenarios, expanding data element infrastructure and services, and enhancing machine vision product lines. The company pursues productization, market expansion domestically and internationally, and innovation in technology, business models, and management. R&D focuses on AI, blockchain, big data, machine vision, and data asset management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based software development and system integration contracts, IT operation and maintenance services, and licensing of proprietary software products. The company also earns income from digital finance platforms, smart manufacturing solutions, and government infrastructure projects, with a predominant direct sales model supplemented by some distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider in digital government and smart enterprise IT services, with a competitive edge in AI-driven solutions and extensive government sector experience. It holds a leading market share in education examination systems and machine vision for manufacturing. Competitors include other domestic IT service providers and emerging AI technology firms, but the company’s comprehensive product portfolio and strong regional presence provide a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 310 million, a 32.53% increase year-over-year, though it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 63.8 million, a significant reduction in loss compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were around RMB 799 million with a net asset value of RMB 309.5 million. It has shown revenue growth but continues to face profitability challenges due to industry competition and project cycle delays.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its 'AI+' core competence, integrating advanced AI large models with domain-specific knowledge graphs to deliver intelligent, efficient, and user-friendly digital government and enterprise solutions. Its differentiated value lies in comprehensive scenario-based services, deep industry expertise, localized customer service teams, and a robust innovation ecosystem supported by extensive patents and certifications. The company also leverages strategic partnerships and proprietary technology to offer high-quality, scalable, and secure digital transformation products.
